Neha Joshi  
📍 Bengaluru, India | 📧 neha.joshi@advervetech.com | 📞 +91 98765 43210 | 🌐 linkedin.com/in/neha-joshi-frontend  

Professional Summary  
A seasoned frontend engineer with 11 years of experience in adtech, specializing in scalable architectures, accessibility-first design, and performance optimization. Recognized for driving cross-functional initiatives that reduced load times by 40% and improved user engagement metrics by 25% across multiple ad platforms. Architect for mission-critical React applications, mentored junior engineers, and led the adoption of TypeScript as a foundational tool across teams. Consistently delivered high-impact solutions that aligned with business goals while maintaining technical excellence.  

Professional Experience  
**Staff Frontend Engineer** | AdVerve Technologies (2018–present)  
- Spearheaded the migration of legacy ad campaign dashboards to a Next.js-based microfrontend architecture, resulting in a 35% reduction in page load times and 50% improvement in user retention metrics.  
- Designed and implemented a GraphQL-powered analytics layer for real-time ad performance tracking, enabling data-driven decisions for 15+ client campaigns.  
- Led the integration of Webpack 5 with Vite for hybrid projects, optimizing build times by 60% and reducing CI pipeline execution duration by 45%.  
- Championed web accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1) across all ad UI components, achieving AAA compliance for 80% of the platform and reducing accessibility-related bug reports by 70%.  
- Collaborated with backend teams to refine REST API endpoints, reducing redundant data fetching by 30% and improving API response consistency across 12+ client integrations.  

**Lead Frontend Engineer** | BannerAds Corp. (2016–2018)  
- Architect for a dynamic ad creative builder tool, leveraging React’s component model to enable reusable UI blocks, which cut development time for new ad templates by 50%.  
- Engineered a performance optimization framework that prioritized critical rendering paths, resulting in a 25% improvement in Time to Interactive (TTI) for ad management interfaces.  
- Pioneered the use of TypeScript in core frontend systems, reducing runtime errors by 40% and improving code maintainability across 10+ modules.  
- Designed a centralized accessibility toolkit for ad UI components, standardizing contrast ratios, keyboard navigation, and ARIA labels across all client-facing products.  

**Senior Frontend Engineer** | ClickMetrics Inc. (2013–2016)  
- Built a real-time ad performance dashboard using React and D3.js, which became a flagship product for 12+ enterprise clients and contributed to a 20% increase in client retention.  
- Developed a Python-based data pipeline to preprocess ad metrics, reducing frontend computation overhead by 35% and improving dashboard responsiveness.  
- Redesigned the company’s ad campaign UI with a focus on progressive enhancement, achieving a 25% reduction in bounce rates and 15% higher conversion rates for client campaigns.  

Technical Skills  
- **JavaScript**: Core to all frontend systems; architecturally shaped component-based design patterns, mentored 5+ junior engineers, and implemented cross-team best practices for state management.  
- **React**: Central to all ad UI development; designed reusable component libraries, optimized reconciliation strategies, and led the transition to React 18 with concurrent mode.  
- **TypeScript**: Integral to modern frontend architecture; enforced type safety across 80% of codebase, reduced runtime errors by 40%, and standardized type definitions for 15+ modules.  
- **Next.js**: Owned the migration of monolithic apps to a Next.js-based microfrontend architecture, resulting in a 35% reduction in server-side rendering (SSR) latency.  
- **Web Accessibility (WCAG)**: Implemented AAA-compliant accessibility patterns across 90% of ad UI components, reducing accessibility-related bug reports by 70%.  
- **Web Performance Optimization**: Engineered critical rendering paths, reduced bundle sizes by 30%, and improved Time to Interactive (TTI) by 25% across ad platforms.  
- **Webpack/Vite**: Integrated Webpack 5 with Vite for hybrid projects, cutting build times by 60% and reducing CI pipeline execution duration by 45%.  
- **GraphQL**: Built and maintained a GraphQL API for ad analytics, enabling real-time data fetching and reducing redundant API calls by 50%.  
- **REST API Design**: Collaborated with backend teams to refine API endpoints, reducing redundant data fetching by 30% and improving API response consistency across 12+ client integrations.  

Projects  
- **Ad Campaign Analytics Dashboard**: Built a real-time dashboard using React and D3.js, reducing data processing time by 40% and increasing client adoption by 25%.  
- **Accessibility Toolkit**: Developed a centralized accessibility library for ad UI components, standardizing contrast ratios, keyboard navigation, and ARIA labels.  
- **Performance Optimization Framework**: Created a framework for critical rendering paths, improving Time to Interactive (TTI) by 25% and reducing bundle sizes by 30%.
